title: A partial refund that writes a split order's first transfer plan pays its sellers but never tells them they made a sale

source.ref: Found by the LIVE-733 builder (#3124, ADR-1700): reverseSplitTransfers plans a paid split order the settle never planned before it writes reversal targets; once that plan exists the reconciler skips the order, and only the settle and the reconciler sent sale notices. ADR-1702

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1702) from the LIVE-733 builder's report (#3124). PREMISE RE-TESTED (ADR-1082) at c0c1b98dc before building: reverseSplitTransfers (lib/commerce/split-refund.ts), on a partial refund of a split order still paid or fulfilled, called planTransfersForOrder(orderId) and discarded the outcome. No notice followed. The settle had found no rows and logged "no seller was notified"; reconcileTransfers step 1 only plans orders with no rows, so after the refund's plan it skipped the order. Step 2 then paid each seller their share (less the refunded part, reversed after) for a sale nobody told them about. A lost dispute for part of the order reaches the same line. WHAT CHANGED. transfers.ts gains noticeRecoveredSellers(orderId, rowIds, context), the reconciler's LIVE-733 block moved into one function: it awaits sendRecoveredSplitSaleNotices (order-receipt.ts, dynamic import) for exactly those rows, logs commerce.transfer.recovered_notice_failed on a throw and commerce.transfer.recovered_notice_missed on a short count, never throws and returns the count. reconcileTransfers step 1 calls it with the same log lines as before. reverseSplitTransfers now keeps its plan and, when the plan returned rowIds, awaits noticeRecoveredSellers(orderId, plan.rowIds, { via: 'split_refund' }) before any reversal target is written, so a database throw later in the refund (the webhook redelivers, and the replay plans nothing) cannot lose the notice. SplitReversalSummary.noticedSellers carries the count into the commerce.split_refund line. ONCE: only the plan call that inserted a row gets its id, so the refund action's own charge.refunded, a redelivery, a top-up, a racing reconciler run, or an order the settle or reconciler already planned tells nobody. A REFUNDED SHARE STILL HEARS OF THE SALE, as it does on the settle path, which tells every seller it planned at plan time and sends no seller a refund notice. A partial refund leaves every planned seller a payout, so the byte-identical LIVE-706 notice goes out. A refund in full writes no plan, pays nobody and tells nobody. No migration, no new notifier. Tests: lib/commerce/split-refund.test.ts (a refund-before-plan tells each seller once across its webhook, a redelivery, a top-up and two cron runs, and the money still moves; an order already planned by the settle or the reconciler tells nobody from the refund; a refund in full tells nobody; a thrown notice is logged with via split_refund, the targets are written and both sellers are paid then reversed; a short notice is logged); lib/commerce/transfers.test.ts unchanged and green through the moved block. All five new tests fail on main.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const fail=(m)=>{console.error("LIVE-739: "+m);process.exit(1)};const read=(f)=>{if(!fs.existsSync(f))fail(f+" is gone");return fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8")};const fnBody=(src,name)=>{const a=src.indexOf("export async function "+name+"(");if(a<0)return null;const b=src.indexOf("\nexport ",a+1);return src.slice(a,b<0?src.length:b)};const S=read("lib/commerce/split-refund.ts");const body=fnBody(S,"reverseSplitTransfers");if(!body)fail("reverseSplitTransfers is gone from lib/commerce/split-refund.ts");const p=body.match(/const\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*await\s+planTransfersForOrder\(\s*orderId\s*\)/);if(!p)fail("a partial refund plans the order and throws the plan away, so it cannot know which sellers it just planned");const n=body.match(new RegExp("await\\s+(\\w+)\\(\\s*orderId\\s*,\\s*"+p[1]+"\\.rowIds"));if(!n)fail("a partial refund writes a split order first plan and sends its sellers no sale notice");if(n[1]!=="sendRecoveredSplitSaleNotices"){const T=fnBody(read("lib/commerce/transfers.ts"),n[1]);if(!T||!/await\s+sendRecoveredSplitSaleNotices\(/.test(T))fail(n[1]+" no longer sends the settle sale notice (sendRecoveredSplitSaleNotices)")}if(!/export async function sendRecoveredSplitSaleNotices\(/.test(read("lib/commerce/order-receipt.ts")))fail("sendRecoveredSplitSaleNotices is gone from lib/commerce/order-receipt.ts");console.log("ok: a partial refund that plans a split order awaits the recovered sale notice for the rows its plan inserted")'
verify.note: In-process. Reads lib/commerce/split-refund.ts: reverseSplitTransfers must keep its planTransfersForOrder(orderId) outcome and await a call with (orderId, <plan>.rowIds). That call is either sendRecoveredSplitSaleNotices or a lib/commerce/transfers.ts export that awaits it (noticeRecoveredSellers). sendRecoveredSplitSaleNotices must still be exported from lib/commerce/order-receipt.ts. Fails on main at c0c1b98dc on the first arm (the plan outcome is thrown away). The behavior (each seller told once, a replay tells nobody, a thrown notice logged and nothing held) is locked by lib/commerce/split-refund.test.ts.
